name: Albany International Corp.
summary:
Albany International (AIN) reported earnings of $0.82 per share on revenue of $329.48 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.80 per share on revenue of $267.51 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 2.50% while revenue grew 5.81% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects third quarter revenue of $320.0 million to $330.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $314.6 million for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.

Albany International Corp is a textiles and materials processing company. It designs, manufactures, and markets paper machine clothing for each section of the paper machine and for every grade of paper.
subject: Albany International Beat Consensus Estimates
